categories.name: Pools.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Pools.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via pools.fun

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Charms Ecosystem
categories.content: Charms Ecosystem features tokenized social assets representing autonomous AI personas, allowing users to trade on the growth and influence of specific AI agents through a bonding curve.

categories.name: Unitas Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens issued by Unitas Labs (unitas.so), a crypto-native yield protocol governed by the Unipay DAO.

categories.name: Fractionalized NFT
categories.content: NFT that is being divided into smaller pieces which have more affordable pieces.

categories.name: PAAL AI Launchpad
categories.content: Projects incubated by PAAL AI, an AI-centric ecosystem built using Custom Data Feed and LLMs.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Hybrid Token Standards
categories.content: Hybrid Token Standards allow tokens to have characteristics of both fungible assets and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Augmented Reality
categories.content: Augmented Reality (AR) offers interactive experiences without disconnecting users from the real world, allowing them to interact with digital elements in a real-world context.

categories.name: DeFi Index
categories.content: A DeFi index is an indicator that tracks the performance of a group of DeFi cryptocurrencies.

categories.name: Metagovernance
categories.content: Metagovernance refers to projects or protocols that primarily hold DAO tokens and actively participates in the governance process of those DAOs.

categories.name: Curve Ecosystem
categories.content: Interconnected platforms and services built around Curve Finance.

categories.name: MMO
categories.content: Online games that host large numbers of players.

categories.name: Reality Ecosystem
categories.content: Reality is a platform by Bitget that issues tokenized real-world assets (like U.S. stocks and ETFs) backed 1:1 by securities, bringing them on-chain with stablecoin dividend payments.

categories.name: Bridged-Tokens
categories.content: Bridged-tokens refers to a token that has been transferred or "bridged" from one blockchain to another, typically through the use of a blockchain bridge.
